About

A bit about me

I'm Felix — 25, based worldwide (I'm traveling roughly half the year; when I'm not, you'll find me in Mannheim, Germany), bilingual in German and American English, plus conversational Chinese (B2/C1). I started creating dedicated UGC content in 2026, building on two years of hands-on social media work for other brands — community building, Meta ads, converting warm leads into paying customers — taught me what actually gets people to stop scrolling and act. These days I'm most drawn to spec ad-creative work — single, high-craft deliverables built to perform as paid ads — over high-volume ambassador retainers.

Outside of content, I run an AI automation agency and I've visited 70+ countries, roughly half of them solo. I script, shoot, and edit everything myself, and I'm actively opening up to travel collaborations — if you need someone who can turn a destination into a scroll-stopping story, that's where I want to spend more time.
